_meta.note: Health-score inputs, per 100 g. Score starts at base_score; each nutrient adds its (negative) impact when the value is STRICTLY greater than gt. The numeric scoring thresholds below are UK FSA traffic-light criteria and project heuristics, not FSSAI-approved health claims or legal limits. FSSAI label requirements are recorded separately in `fssai_label_requirements`; use those for label-data completeness, not for a health-pass decision. Beverages (per 100 ml, or a category listed in beverage_categories) use half of the scoring thresholds listed in beverage_halved.
_meta.source: FSSAI Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020, consolidated compendium Version VIII (09 Sep 2025), official regulations index accessed 26 Sep 2026: https://www.fssai.gov.in/docs/food-law/regulations/Comp_Labelling%20Display_Version%20VIII_09_09_2025.pdf

verification.regulatory_scope: FSSAI requires nutrition information on the label but does not publish one universal healthy/unhealthy score threshold for all packaged foods.

fssai_label_requirements.source: FSSAI Labelling and Display Regulations 2020, nutrition information provisions; see _meta.source
fssai_label_requirements.note: A missing field should be reported as unavailable for label review. It must not be treated as zero or as evidence that a product is compliant.

completeness.note: data_completeness is 'full' only if all of these are present and usable.
